project.title: Eclipse Phase 2e Character & Morph Creator
project.summary: A local-first web tool for creating, validating, saving, resleeving, and printing Eclipse Phase Second Edition characters.

items.title: Verify grayscale dossiers on a physical printer
items.notes: Print synthetic player and GM dossiers on a physical printer using its grayscale setting. Check legibility, clipped margins, page breaks, repeated skill headings, and the selected private-note output on paper. The digital print and accessibility audit is complete in verify-accessibility-and-layouts.
